title: Downtown Escape/12 Beds/Rftop Deck/2nd Home Option
description:
Book any 3 night weekend stay and get a 4th night absolutely FREE. TWO MILES TO BROADWAY! 

** Home Highlights:**
**Spacious Bedrooms**: 4 large bedrooms, each tastefully decorated, ensuring comfort for all guests with a total of 14 BEDS!!!!
 **Rooftop Deck**: Experience breathtaking Nashville skyline views from our furnished rooftop deck.
**Modern Amenities**: Fully equipped kitchen, high-speed WiFi, smart TVs, and a convenient laundry setup.

The space
Welcome to our luxurious 4-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom Nashville home, a perfect retreat for families or large parties looking to experience the best of Music City. Boasting a stunning rooftop deck with skyline views, our home combines modern amenities with a warm, welcoming atmosphere.

Each home has:

**Family & Event Ready**: Whether it’s a family reunion or a celebratory gathering, our home caters to all.

*3.5 Bathrooms with luxurious showers and tubs - Easy for Everyone to Get Ready

*Rooftop Deck w/Downtown Views

*Fast WiFi and Cable TV

*Free, Private Parking (Room for 2 Cars) 

*Brand-new, Modern Kitchen

*Keyless Entry/Self Check-in

*Full-Sized Washer/Dryer for your Convenience

*Coffee and Essentials Provided
Bedroom 1) 1 Queen

Bedroom 2) 2 Queen 4 twin

Bedroom 3) 2 Queen 2 Twin

Bedroom 4) 1 Queen

2 Properties Located Side by Side! Homes can be booked INDIVIDUALLY or TOGETHER. If you instant book, YOU WILL BE BOOKING ONE OF TWO  HOME. 

Please contact us BEFORE booking if you would like to book BOTH homes. 

Price Reflects single unit. Decor is subject to change.

 In order to receive promotional discount, it must be requested at the time of booking.

Guest access
You`ll have 100% private access to this home during your entire stay, except for one closet that I keep for personal belongings and supplies.

Other things to note
We provide everything that a hotel will have. There will be enough tissue, paper towels, garbage bags, etc. to get you started. If you need additional supplies family dollar and Kroger are less than a mile away. We only provide breakfast essentials such as coffee, sugar, etc..

Bachelor and Bachelorette parties are welcome!!
